changes: 24-Hour Update Check Rate-Limiting: Automatic background launch update check now respects a strict 24-hour rate limit so it checks at most once per day without pestering.
Auto-Close on Outside Clicks: Added precise window frame bounds checking so clicking anywhere outside the popover automatically closes it without desaturating the background.

Seamless Launch Accessibility Permission Prompt: Automatically prompts for macOS Accessibility permissions once on first launch so double-click direct paste works seamlessly out of the box without pestering.

Color Preview Swatches: Added automatic detection of hex, RGB, and HSL color codes with inline 32x32 color swatches, color filter bar, and toast preview. Requires explicit '#' prefix for hex codes to avoid false positives.
QuickLook Document Previews: Integrated QLThumbnailGenerator for PDF, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, and Keynote 1st-page document thumbnails at 320x320 Retina quality with async non-blocking generation.
Instant Single Click Expand: Eliminated 400ms double-click timeout delay for instant row expansion.
Translucent Glass Polish: Standardized popover translucent glass background in Light and Dark modes.

Clean File Display & Video Previews: File paths are now displayed as clean file names instead of full path URIs. Added video frame snapshot previews for video files and file icon thumbnails for documents.
Direct Paste on Double-Click: Double-clicking any item now instantly closes the popover and pastes the selection directly to wherever the active cursor is.
UI Polish: Removed redundant 'Pin All Pinned' option when right-clicking the Pinned filter button.

Virtualized Large File Editor: Replaced SwiftUI TextEditor with AppKit NSTextView non-contiguous layout virtualization (allowsNonContiguousLayout = true) for 0% CPU scrolling through 50,000+ line files.
Read-Only Safety Guard: Added Read-Only mode for massive files exceeding 100,000 characters to prevent main-thread re-encryption freezes on save.
Async Background Loading: Offloaded large clip content loading to background queues for instant modal presentation.
Multi-Release Changelog Parsing: Update dialog now dynamically displays all release notes for versions between your current build and the latest version.
URLCache Hard Purge: Added strict cache clearing to guarantee instant detection of remote releases.
Smooth Changelog Scrolling: Replaced legacy AppKit NSTextView inside Update Alert with hardware-accelerated SwiftUI ScrollView for 60 FPS / 120 FPS ProMotion trackpad scrolling.
Update Check Cache Bypass: Added dynamic cache-busting timestamp parameter to update checker to guarantee real-time update notifications without CDN caching delays.

Large Payload Offloading: Clips exceeding 15,000 characters (e.g. 6,000+ line HTML files, minified bundles, or large logs) are automatically offloaded into dedicated encrypted payload files, preserving 100% full text without truncating a single character.
Ultra-Lightweight Storage: Reduced primary history index file size by 99.8% (from ~18MB to ~35KB) for instant app startup and zero disk write overhead.

Hybrid Instant + Debounced Deep Search: Real-time O(1) instant search on preview text on every keypress, paired with debounced background deep-searching of large payload files for maximum UI responsiveness.
High-Performance String & Duplicate Checks: Optimized grapheme cluster prefixing and byte-length pre-checks for instant duplicate detection and fluid 60 FPS scrolling.
1-Click In-App Auto-Update: Automatically downloads installer and runs Terminal auto-update flow.
Automatically open popover when toggling Resizable Menu setting for seamless window scaling.
Standardized bundle identifier to com.aoh.cliplocal across app bundle, Info.plist, and launch agent.
Right-Click Edit: Added ability to right-click and edit any saved clipboard item with a indicator icon.
Full Editor Shortcuts: Text editor now supports standard macOS keyboard shortcuts (⌘C, ⌘V, ⌘X, ⌘Z, ⌘A).
Smart Clean on Empty Edit: Completely clearing text when editing automatically deletes the clip from history.
Broader Code Detection: Enhanced categorization to recognize bash and shell scripts (cat, tail, grep, curl, etc.) with precise regex to prevent false positives on plain English text.
Fixed a bug where the keyboard shortcut badges (⌘1-⌘9) showed the wrong index.
Fixed a bug where the popover could not be dragged beyond 1000px on large displays like iMacs. It now scales dynamically.
Smart Cleanup: ClipLocal now automatically garbage collects old Universal Clipboard (Handoff) file proxy links to prevent pasting dead links.
Major performance fix: Context menus now read from a centralized O(1) cache instead of performing O(N) array calculations on every UI refresh.
UI Polish: Context menu actions (Pin/Unpin/Delete) now feature native macOS system icons.
Settings Menu Polish: The Settings menu now instantly reads counts from the centralized cache.
Added dynamic item counts to the 'Clear History' and 'Unpin All' buttons in the Settings menu.
Major Engine Overhaul: Expanding rows and scrolling is now hyper-optimized.
Introduced native NSCache for images and regex evaluations to eliminate main-thread lag.
List filtering is now cached dynamically, guaranteeing stable 60 FPS while scrolling.
Added zero-delay timestamp tracker for instant click responses.
Multiple rows can now be expanded simultaneously without UI shifting.
Popovers now reliably clear all memory states immediately upon closing.
Fixed an issue where long metadata labels (like high-res image dimensions) would wrap to a second line.
Dynamic file types: Metadata row now dynamically extracts the exact extension to display 'JPG image' or 'SRT file' instead of generic labels.
Added large image preview: clicking an image row now elegantly expands to show a full preview of the image.
Major UI enhancement for image copies: Thumbnail moved to icon position.
Smarter image titles: Automatically extracts filenames from browser copies instead of saying [Image].
Streamlined metadata text: Date format shortened and image dimensions accurately displayed on one line.
Removed 'Show image dimensions' toggle in favor of native UI display.
Fixed issue where images with extracted filenames were incorrectly filtered as text.
Clipboard items now have a stable UUID identity — no more ghost references after copying.
History now saves in the background — no more main-thread stutter on copy.
Trimming history now correctly syncs to disk immediately.
'Keep up to' limit expanded to 1,000 items.
Reducing the item limit now shows a confirmation before deleting older entries.
Copy-button checkmark no longer shows stale state when reopening ClipLocal.
'Get Started' on the About screen no longer accidentally closes the popover.
Smooth 60 fps scrolling: extracted per-row view to isolate hover-state re-renders.
Cached app icons via AppIconCache — no more repeated disk I/O per render.
Shared DateFormatter singleton to avoid expensive allocations on every row.
Replaced O(n²) firstIndex scan with O(n) enumerated index for shortcut badges.
Fixed CI build pipeline and homebrew tap workflow.
